entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A loxodon Lorehold scholarship student, shepherd's son, and archaeomancer who works at a dig and is assigned the spirit of Asterion as mentor.

entities.name: Asterion
entities.description: A spirit summoned into his statue, a noble who died six hundred years ago in a cave while seeking the lost city of Zantafar.

entities.name: Hofri Ghostforge
entities.description: A Lorehold professor and dig project lead, who can rouse spirits without a statue and offers Quint empathy.

entities.name: Plargg
entities.description: A Lorehold dean who paired students with recently excavated statues and dislikes quitters.

entities.name: Siulogma of Valdrasheen
entities.description: A celebrated scholar spirit who was Hofri's mentor and disliked him.

entities.name: Vis Svokunol
entities.description: A loxodon veteran and Asterion's childhood caretaker, accused of being a mercenary and put to death in a stockade.

entities.name: Teutamos
entities.description: Asterion's father, lord of Pallad Reach, who condemned Vis to the stockade.

entities.name: Huerty Kostambul
entities.description: The loxodon commandant of Rundlestrom Military Academy who expelled Quint.

entities.name: Xyrun-Jed
entities.description: The last loxodon emperor, credited with the Canticle of Jed and with the fall of Zantafar.

entities.name: Golwanda the Bloodspiller
entities.description: An orcish warlord with Thunder Riders, whose statue stands on Effigy Row.

entities.name: Xandril the Executioner
entities.description: A kor war hero and enemy of Golwanda, whose statue stands on Effigy Row.

entities.name: Zantafar
entities.description: A legendary lost loxodon city hidden beneath Pillardrop and found by Quint and Asterion.

entities.name: Pillardrop
entities.description: The ridge with caves and a dig site near Strixhaven where Zantafar is hidden.

entities.name: Effigy Row
entities.description: A section of Lorehold College lined with statues of heroes, where mentor spirits are summoned.

entities.name: Lorehold College
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of history and archaeomancy.

entities.name: Moragitzu-Kesh
entities.description: An ancient city that researchers believe lies under Strixhaven.

entities.name: Tarangrad
entities.description: The town where Vis was imprisoned.

entities.name: Rundlestrom Military Academy
entities.description: The military academy that expelled Quint.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The school of mages on Arcavios.

entities.name: Canticle of Jed
entities.description: A loxodon prayer and poem that acts as the key to opening the entrance to Zantafar.

entities.name: The Rousing
entities.description: Lorehold's most important archaeomancy spell that projects the caster's will back through time and calls spirits into statues.

events.summary: Quint grows tired of his spirit mentor Asterion, who talks only of scones and trivia.
events.quote: Five minutes into his first encounter with Asterion, Quintorius decided that he had heard just about enough from his spirit mentor.

events.summary: Quint performs the Rousing, a burst of heatless flame that animates Asterion's statue.
events.quote: a bright burst of heatless flame engulfed the statue

events.summary: Quint reads Asterion his genealogy from the school's records.
events.quote: Your father was Lord Teutamos of Pallad Reach

events.summary: Quint asks about Asterion's death, noting reports he left toward Pillardrop and was never found.
events.quote: A series of reports indicate that you were last seen leaving the school grounds traveling toward Pillardrop.

events.summary: Asterion says his memories of the end are fragments.
events.quote: Would you believe me if I told you that I can't quite recall?

events.summary: Asterion asks to see the cave, but Quint says spirit statues cannot leave Effigy Row.
events.quote: Spirit statues aren't permitted to leave Effigy Row.

events.summary: Quint reveals he helps at the dig where Asterion's statue was found, hoping to prove the school sits on Moragitzu-Kesh.
events.quote: it's the cave where they found your statue buried under an ancient rockslide

events.summary: Asterion recites the Canticle of Jed and says the lost city is Zantafar, which he sought long ago.
events.quote: I know enough not to mistake Zantafar for Moragitzu-Kesh.

events.summary: Asterion urges Quint to find the lost city of Zantafar as his responsibility.
events.quote: There's a lost city to discover.

events.summary: Quint and the unauthorized Asterion sneak past the dig camp at Pillardrop.
events.quote: Quint spotted Professor Hofri Ghostforge, the project lead, warming himself by the fire

events.summary: Quint recalls using magic to defeat three hazing cadets, which got him expelled from Rundlestrom (flashback).
events.quote: It was a fairly simple matter to reach out and drop a wall banner on the head of one attacker

events.summary: Quint stumbles and is caught by Professor Ghostforge, while Asterion hides.
events.quote: Why are you not back at campus?

events.summary: Hofri tells Quint about his own unhappy mentor Siulogma and offers to talk any time.
events.quote: You know you can talk to me any time.

events.summary: Asterion leads Quint into a cave and recognizes a stone column.
events.quote: I remember this formation distinctly.

events.summary: Quint's magical map shows others have explored the cave before.
events.quote: A single point of golden energy flared upward from the page.

events.summary: Quint, angry at the empty cave, shouts at Asterion, who reveals he overheard him call him a disappointment.
events.quote: In life, I was partially deaf in the left ear.

events.summary: Asterion tells how his caretaker Vis was arrested in Tarangrad and left to die in a stockade (flashback).
events.quote: By the time I reached Tarangrad, it was too late.

events.summary: Asterion leaves home for good to find Zantafar in Vis's name (flashback).
events.quote: I left that day never to return.

events.summary: Quint recites the Canticle of Jed and the stone column retracts to reveal a dark shaft.
events.quote: A low rumble shook the cave, and with a grinding sound, the column retracted into the ground, leaving a hole that led to pitch-black darkness.

events.summary: Asterion warns Quint that he did not return from here and describes the afterlife as a place of forgetting.
events.quote: Do you know what it's like to be dead?

events.summary: Quint ropes down into the shaft.
events.quote: With a push of his legs, Quint lowered himself into the darkness.

events.summary: Quint finds an enormous golden statue of a loxodon in a chamber.
events.quote: an enormous golden statue of a loxodon in repose

events.summary: They find Asterion's mummified body below, broken by a fall.
events.quote: Quint approached and saw a human body, or what was left of one after six hundred years.

events.summary: Asterion admits he fell to his death and thought his life meaningless.
events.quote: I didn't think it would be so far down.

events.summary: Quint shows Asterion the lost city of Zantafar spread beneath them.
events.quote: a sprawling ghost metropolis rose from the stone, lit in an eternal twilight by luminescent fungi above

relations.note: Asterion's spirit is Quint's assigned mentor.
Hofri is project lead of the dig for Lorehold.
relations.quote: Professor Hofri Ghostforge, the project lead
In death she was, among other things, Hofri's assigned mentor
Your father was Lord Teutamos of Pallad Reach

relations.note: Teutamos condemned Vis to death under the law.
relations.quote: When I confronted him, he wouldn't give me an answer as to why he condemned Vis to death
levied every threat he could think of to Quint's physical health
